desc:
🌴 Welcome to One Block

Start on a tiny floating island and expand it one block at a time!

🪓 Chop trees and gather resources
⛏️ Mine rocks, coal, metal, and more
🧱 Unlock hundreds of new island blocks
🛠️ Discover resources and craft new materials
💪 Upgrade your power and collect faster
🌎 Explore new zones and complete the entire island

Every block brings you closer to a bigger and better island. How far can you expand?

⭐ Like the game and favorite it for future updates!
